in_hebrew.name: חבקוק
in_hebrew.meaning: חבקוק - נביא שראה וחזה את המשפטים והרעות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חבקוק הוא שם נביא מקראי שפירושו 'חיבוק' או 'אחיזה חזקה'. הנביא חבקוק היה אחד מהנביאים הקטנים בספר התנ"ך, והוא ידוע בשל ספרו הנבואי המכיל תפילות, קינות, והתפללויות. הנביא חבקוק חי בתקופת המלך יהויקים ודיבר על הצרות והמשפטים שיבואו על עם ישראל.

in_greek.name: Αββακούμ
in_greek.meaning: Αββακούμ - προφήτης που είδε και προέβλεψε κρίσεις και κακά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αββακούμ είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος חבקוק. Ο προφήτης Αββακούμ ήταν ένας από τους μικρούς προφήτες της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης και είναι γνωστός για το προφητικό του βιβλίο που περιέχει προσευχές, θρήνη και δοξαστικά. Ο προφήτης Αββακούμ έζησε κατά τη διάρκεια του βασιλιά Ιωακείμ και μίλησε για τις συμφορές και τις κρίσεις που θα ερχόταν στον λαό του Ισραήλ.

in_latin.name: Habacuc
in_latin.meaning: Habacuc - propheta qui vidit et praevidit judicia et mala
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Habacuc est forma latina nominis hebraici חבקוק. Propheta Habacuc fuit unus ex prophetis minoribus in Veteri Testamento et notus est propter librum suum propheticum qui continet orationes, lamenta et hymnos. Propheta Habacuc vixit tempore regis Ioacim et locutus est de calamitatibus et iudiciis quae ventura erant super populum Israel.

in_english.name: Habakkuk
in_english.meaning: Prophet who embraces or holds on tightly to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Habakkuk originates from the Hebrew name חבקוק (Habakuk), which means 'to embrace' or 'to hold on tightly'. Habakkuk was a prophet in the Old Testament, specifically in the book of Habakkuk. He is known for his prophecies and prayers, often questioning God's justice and timing. The name Habakkuk symbolizes a strong faith and trust in God, even in times of uncertainty and turmoil. It is a unique and meaningful name with a rich biblical heritage.

biblical_reference.note: The Book of Habakkuk is one of the twelve minor prophets in the Old Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Habakkuk holds a significant cultural impact as it represents a strong belief in holding fast to one's faith and embracing the challenges that life may present. It is a reminder of the steadfastness and resilience of the Hebrew people, who despite facing immense struggles and adversity, continued to trust in the power and justice of God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Habakkuk holds deep spiritual significance for Christians as it symbolizes the unwavering faith and trust in God's plan, even during times of uncertainty and hardship. It is a reminder to hold on to God's promises and to embrace the faith that sustains us, even when we may not fully understand the reasons behind the events in our lives. The book of Habakkuk, with its powerful prophecies and reminders of God's justice and faithfulness, continues to inspire and challenge believers to this day.

historical_references.reference: The prophet Habakkuk is mentioned in the Old Testament, in the book that bears his name. He is believed to have prophesied during the time of the Babylonian captivity of Judah (605-539 BC), when the Jews were being carried off to Babylon by King Nebuchadnezzar.

The book of Habakkuk is a poetic and powerful expression of the Prophet's faith in God's ultimate control over human affairs despite the chaos and injustice in the world. This theme is expressed in the prophecy of the coming of the Chaldeans (Babylonians) to conquer Judah, and in Habakkuk's faith that God will bring about justice and judgement in His own time and way.
historical_references.context: Prophetic writings expressing faith in God's control over human affairs
